governance_note: Define states clearly and review whether the state space is complete enough.
Document row-stochastic or column-stochastic convention and update rule.
State the transition interval and avoid reusing probabilities across incompatible time scales.
Check nonnegativity and row or column sums before downstream analysis.
Review whether transition probabilities remain valid over the modeled horizon.
Interpret steady states as model-implied distributions, not automatic value claims.
